title: ElevenLabs Professional Voice Cloning: Clone Your Own Voice
desc:
ElevenLabs tutorial: ElevenLabs Professional Voice Cloning: Clone Your Own Voice.

A Professional Voice Clone trains a dedicated model on hours of your own voice. This episode covers who can create one, the documented steps from upload to Use, how much audio to record, what to put in the samples, how to pass verification, the fine-tuning statuses, slots per plan, the models and languages it trains on, and the most common error.

This episode is a documented walkthrough built from the official ElevenLabs documentation (links below). It does not include a live product recording.
